runSummary.stalePolicy: LIVE eligibility requires real source verification; touching timestamps is not verification. Existing records keep their own verifiedAt unless their public detail was actually reopened or otherwise reconfirmed.
runSummary.note: Fresh 12.9.2026 01:58 sweep actually searched 11 source families: Profesia, direct-company careers, LinkedIn Jobs public index, Worki, Brigada.sk, Kariera/Zoznam, Praca za rohom, Pretlak/StartupJobs/WordPress Jobs, Upwork, Reddit/WordPress communities and Facebook public indexing. No new promotion-grade unique hit cleared location, language, qualification, economics, freshness and trust gates. LinkedIn again surfaced Marlink Support Engineer in Bratislava with B2 English and telecom/networking requirements, already known and above target. Kariera surfaced customer-support inventory including a German-language Grafton support role and several low-pay/general customer-service roles, but no same-run canonical detail justified LIVE promotion. Upwork surfaced several Worldwide WordPress/VA/support roles: the 30 USD fixed AI-blog workload is economically unacceptable, Website Design & Development VA requires excellent written English plus portfolio evidence, WordPress ongoing development requires fluent spoken English, Hong Kong timezone overlap and complex plugin work, and WordPress/Elementor support combines urgent 15-minute ticket response with deeper hosting/DNS/caching troubleshooting. Reddit surfaced a concrete hiring post restricted to US-based WordPress developers; other visible posts were supply-side FOR HIRE. Facebook again produced 0 concrete verifiable hiring posts.

developmentBacklogAdded.title: Canonical apply-state reachability probe
developmentBacklogAdded.reason: Do not treat a listing as actionable solely because its detail page still renders. Verify that the canonical apply action or application form is actually reachable and not silently closed, expired or redirected; store the evidence and timestamp. This reduces false LIVE confidence from stale pages that remain indexed after hiring has stopped.

developmentBacklogAdded.title: Rejection reversal trigger
developmentBacklogAdded.reason: Persist the primary reject reason and automatically reopen a candidate for verification when a later canonical snapshot materially changes that exact blocker, such as remote eligibility, language requirement, contract type or salary. This prevents previously rejected but improved listings from being permanently suppressed.
